articles.title: Returns policy
articles.body: You can return shoes within 30 days of purchase. Items must be unworn. Start a return from your order page.

articles.title: Shipping times
articles.body: Standard shipping takes 2 to 4 business days. Orders over 50 dollars ship for free.

articles.title: Size guide
articles.body: Measure your foot in the evening. If you are between sizes, choose the larger one.

articles.title: Gift cards
articles.body: Gift cards never expire and can be used for shoes, boots and accessories.

articles.title: Exchanges
articles.body: To exchange shoes for another size, start a return and place a new order.
